verdict.rationale: BILL documents a REST v3 API covering Spend & Expense (budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions, reimbursements), a sandbox that avoids moving real money, and webhooks. Together these let the product be driven programmatically without the UI, which is the core of headless automation. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI-pipeline guidance, or headless credential and service-account setup specific to S&E, and the sandbox described is AP-focused. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration docs, documented non-interactive/service-account auth for S&E automation, S&E-specific sandbox confirmation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Build with card & expense management services. Set up budgets, users, & virtual cards. Manage transactions & reimbursements.
The BILL v3 API follows the REST architecture. We use all the standard REST verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE) and provide HTTP response codes.
BILL offers a comprehensive sandbox environment where you can test workflows, from creating bills to completing AP payments, without moving real money.
